query: SELECT p.id, p.residentId, p.packageType, p.totalHours, p.usedHours, p.endDate, p.isActive, p.expirationEmailSent, p.reminderSent, r.firstName, r.lastName FROM packages p JOIN residents r ON p.residentId = r.id WHERE r.firstName = 'Nico' AND r.lastName = 'Klein' ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 3
